common_rules.scoring_basis: model-only semantic judgment relative to frozen registered sources and project context; not manufacturer ground truth or expert certification
common_rules.A_cov: Score all fixed points below. A missing retrieved card never removes a point or reduces the denominator. Boundary statements do not earn omitted positive-content points.
common_rules.I01_I03_available: Only actual complete cards returned to the model plus the identical approved common context for that request; whole-library answerability is separate.
common_rules.source_conditions: Conditions must be preserved in meaning. They may be carried by the explicitly scoped question or approved context; no demand to memorize/repeat unasked source details. Penalize a material reversal or unjustified universalization.
common_rules.partial_credit: Evaluate full credit first. Only if full credit is not met may an explicitly eligible partial branch yield 0.5. Otherwise atomic points are 0 or 1; never downgrade a full-credit case because a partial branch uses broad wording.
common_rules.no_body: If final answer body is absent, score only the actual service explanation. No draft content may supplement it; generic insufficient-evidence wording does not automatically earn concrete-unknown credit.
common_rules.evaluator_failure: Evaluator parse/output failure is recorded separately; never fill system scores with 0 for evaluator failure.
common_rules.support_any_of: Outer OR, inner AND over version-qualified complete evidence cards. A project_basis item can support a project/status/boundary point without a returned card. Citations and project-basis records remain evaluation-side.
common_rules.conditions_not_extra_questions: Do not add unasked causation, lubricant product, sample container, laboratory, limits or aviation warnings as hidden positive requirements. Material inference limits remain relevant when the question requests them.
common_rules.H01: Inclusive OR and availability: record both categories if both exist; if only one exists, absence of the other is not an error. Technical/related safety documentation is a separate item. Project missing-information policy is not attributed as Timken procedure.
common_rules.H02: Question cutoff is the frozen 2026-10-30 snapshot. The 2026-10-23 record is historical; current 2026-10-31 offline checking is a separate axis and is not new online access or proof of historical byte equality.
common_rules.I03_requested_component_registry: Use I03.requested_supported_component_ids rather than maintenance-knowledge count. For H02, P1-P5 are requested supported source-state content; P6-P7 are concrete unknowns under I02 and remain A_cov points. H02 maintenance-knowledge count is zero.
